nav.label: Settings pages
nav.title: Settings
nav.lede: Your organisation, the channels residents hear from you on, and data security

general.title: Settings
general.description: The company details printed on documents and the rules every building follows. Each change takes effect when you choose and keeps its reason.

readOnlyTitle: Read-only while the subscription is suspended
readOnlyBody: Settings can be changed again once the subscription is reinstated.

key.invoice_min_lead_days: Days between issue and due date
key.access_work_order_window_hours: Door code for a work order
key.viewing_self_code_minutes: Viewing code valid after the slot starts
key.viewing_self_code_early_minutes: Viewing code valid before the slot starts
key.compliance_tariff_cap_representative_uni: Usage a new rate is checked at

property.title: Building settings
property.description: Billing cycle, cut-off and grace per property. A value set here overrides the tenant's for the buildings of this property.
property.noneHint: Building rules apply once you add your first property.

editor.title: Change {name}
editor.tenantScope: For every building of the tenant, unless a property sets its own.
editor.propertyScope: For the buildings of this property only.
editor.afterHoursHint: Hours after the cycle is computed without anyone issuing it
editor.estimateAllow: Allow estimates when a reading is missing

history.title: Versions of {name}
history.description: The platform default, your company's and the building's versions, newest first — a change scheduled for later is marked.

company.title: Company data
company.description: Printed on invoices, receipts and tax invoices.
company.editHint: Changes apply to documents issued from now on.
company.legalNameHint: As on the company or personal registration
company.vatHint: Invoices then show VAT and the VAT working figures appear in reports
company.logoHint: PNG, JPG or SVG, up to 2 MB
company.logoTooLarge: The image is larger than 2 MB

bank.title: Bank accounts
bank.description: The accounts residents pay into. Adding or changing one is confirmed with a one-time code sent to the owner's phone.
bank.addHint: Payments go to this account once the code sent to your phone confirms it.
bank.accountNameHint: Exactly as the bank has it
bank.providerHint: The bank or gateway that issues the QR codes and confirms payments
bank.merchantRefHint: From the provider's merchant contract, when there is one
bank.buildingsHint: Leave all unticked for every building
bank.otpBody: Enter the code sent by SMS to confirm {bank} {account}.
bank.otpNeedsResend: Send a new code to confirm this account.
bank.removeBody: Residents can no longer pay into this {bank} account. Payments already received stay.
bank.emptyHint: Add the account residents pay into to issue invoices with a Thai QR.
bank.listHint: Residents pay into these accounts; bills carry their Thai QR

members.title: Members
members.description: The people who work for your tenant and what each may do. Staff can be limited to some buildings.
members.inviteHint: They join with the role you choose once they accept.
members.buildingsHint: Leave all unticked for every building
members.removeBody: They lose access to this tenant at once. What they did stays in the audit log.
members.teamHint: People who can open this console; their role decides what each can do
members.noInvitationsHint: Invitations you send stay here until they are accepted or expire

notifications.title: Notifications to residents
notifications.description: Which channels each resident message goes out on. Urgent messages ignore quiet hours.
notifications.quietHoursHint: Quiet hours are set on the <link>general page</link>.
notifications.matrixHint: Choose the channels of each message. Urgent ones go out even in quiet hours.

eventHint.invoice_issued: When the month's bill is issued, with a pay link
eventHint.invoice_reminder: On the reminder days after the due date
eventHint.invoice_overdue: When a bill is past its due date
eventHint.lease_sent_for_signature: The link to sign the lease online
eventHint.lease_signed: When everyone has signed, with a copy
eventHint.deposit_refunded: When the deposit is refunded after move-out
eventHint.parcel_arrived: When a parcel arrives at the front desk

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Your consents as an operator and the residents' data requests to your tenant (PDPA).
privacy.consentsHint: Purposes you accepted; optional ones can be withdrawn at any time.

dsr.title: Data subject requests
dsr.description: Residents' requests about their data. PDPA gives 30 days to answer; overdue requests are marked.
dsr.notesHint: Kept with the request; required to reject

verify.title: Verify the person's identity?
verify.body: Record that you checked who made this {kind} request.

start.title: Start working on it?
start.body: The {kind} request moves to in progress.

fulfil.title: Fulfil the request?
fulfil.body: For access or portability an export file is produced; for erasure the person's data is anonymised where no legal hold applies. ({kind})

reject.title: Reject the request?
reject.body: Explain why in the notes — the person is told. ({kind})

dsr.emptyHint: Residents' requests to see, fix or erase their data arrive here with their legal due date

support.title: Support access
support.description: Requests from getproperty support to read your data for a ticket. Nothing is changed under a grant, and every read is in your audit log.
support.approveTitle: Allow getproperty support to read your data?
support.hoursHint: The platform caps the hours; access ends by itself
support.denyBody: Support will not get access for this ticket.
support.liveTitle: {count, plural, one {Support can read your data now} other {# support grants are live}}
support.liveBody: Every read under a grant is listed in the <audit>audit log</audit>.

via.platform_admin_incident: Approved by the platform for an incident

support.emptyHint: Requests appear here when support needs to look at your data.
support.pendingHint: Once approved, support can read your data for the time you set — never change it
support.historyHint: Requests that ended, were revoked or denied

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what and when in your tenant, including reads by support under a grant.
audit.emptyFilteredHint: Try another area or a wider date range
audit.emptyHint: Important changes and support reads are recorded here

grants.title: Access grants
grants.description: Buildings or units you opened to another getproperty customer (a management company, a contractor) or that were opened to you.
grants.createHint: They see the building (or unit) in their own console with the access you choose.
grants.granteeHint: Ask the other tenant for their id
grants.modulesHint: Comma separated, e.g. readings, invoices; empty for all
grants.validToHint: Leave empty for no end date
grants.revokeBody: The other tenant loses access at once.
grants.emptyHint: Grants appear here when you open a building to another tenant.
grants.listHint: Who sees which building, how much they may do, and until when

signIn.title: Ways to sign in
signIn.description: How you can open this console. They belong to your own account, not to the organisation.
signIn.kept: Carries your LINE notifications, so it stays
signIn.removeTitle: Remove {provider} from your ways to sign in?
signIn.removeBody: You will no longer sign in with {provider}; use one of the other ways. You can add it again any time.
signIn.linked: {provider} added — you can sign in with {provider} next time.
signIn.footnote: getproperty never merges accounts by e-mail; an account that already belongs to someone else is not moved.
signIn.listHint: They belong to your own account, not the company

lineOa.title: Your LINE OA
lineOa.description: Send bills, repair updates and announcements to residents from your own LINE Official Account instead of getproperty’s

how.title: How to connect
how.step1: In LINE Developers, create a Messaging API channel for your LINE Official Account
how.step2: Copy its Channel ID, Channel secret and long-lived Channel access token here
how.step3: Paste the Webhook URL you get into the channel and turn on “Use webhook”
how.step4: Residents who follow the OA get a link to confirm; once they do, messages come from your OA

lineOa.shared: Until a resident confirms, their messages keep coming through getproperty’s LINE, so no bill is missed
lineOa.emptyHint: All messages are sent from getproperty’s LINE for now
lineOa.connectHint: Everything is in LINE Developers on that OA’s channel. We store it encrypted and never show it again
lineOa.scopeHint: Pick one building if each building has its own OA; buildings without one use the OA set for all buildings
lineOa.replaceNote: An OA already connected for this scope is replaced
lineOa.failedConnect: Saved, but LINE does not accept it yet. Check the access token and run the check again
lineOa.webhookHint: Paste it in LINE Developers › Messaging API › Webhook URL and turn on “Use webhook”
lineOa.linked: {count, plural, one {# resident confirmed} other {# residents confirmed}}
lineOa.revokeBody: Messages go back to getproperty’s LINE at once. Residents who confirmed must confirm again if you reconnect

usage.title: Messages this month
usage.beyond: {count, number} messages over the free ones, about {amount} + VAT {vat}
usage.own: {count, number} messages through your OA — LINE bills you; getproperty charges nothing
usage.fallbacks: {count, plural, one {LINE refused # message for quota; it went by SMS where a phone was known} other {LINE refused # messages for quota; they went by SMS where a phone was known}}

addon.changed: The prices just changed — read the new ones and accept again.
addon.monthly: Monthly {amount} before VAT, from next month — the month you connect is free
addon.setup: One-off setup {amount} before VAT, invoiced once connected
addon.setupCharged: The setup fee was charged already — never twice
addon.how: Fees are invoiced by getproperty; LINE bills message charges to your LINE OA account directly.
addon.free: Connecting the agency's own LINE OA has no fee yet — it stays free until getproperty publishes a price.
addon.lineCharges: An unpaid fee never stops the system. LINE bills the messages sent through your OA to you directly.

verification.title: Identity
verification.description: Verify once with your ID card and a selfie. People looking to rent see “Identity verified” on your listings and owner page.
verification.verifiedBody: Verified on {date}. The badge shows on all your listings and your owner page.
verification.unavailableTitle: Online identity verification is not offered yet
verification.unavailableBody: We are choosing a licensed identity provider. Once it is ready you can start here. Unit ownership verification works as before.
verification.pendingBody: Started. You can continue on the provider’s page until {date}, then come back here for the result.
verification.rejectedNoReason: The provider gave no reason. Try again somewhere with good light.
verification.expired: Your last attempt ran out of time. You can start again.

card.title: Photograph your ID card
card.body: On the licensed provider’s page. It takes about 5 minutes.

selfie.title: Take a selfie
selfie.body: To confirm the card is yours.

result.title: Get the result at once
result.body: You come back here automatically; the badge shows as soon as you pass.

why.badge: “Identity verified” shows on your listings, your owner page and in chats with people who enquire.
why.trust: Renters know they are talking to the real owner, not a scammer.
why.privacy: We keep only the outcome — never your ID number, card photo or date of birth.

verification.startBody: Verify with your ID card and a selfie at a licensed e-KYC provider; once it passes, the "identity verified" mark shows on your listings

groupHint.billing: Cut-off, grace period and how the monthly bills go out
groupHint.collections: Reminders, late fees and how residents may pay
groupHint.notifications: When non-urgent messages wait, and the satisfaction survey
groupHint.readings: Photos, reading rounds and the range a reading may fall in
groupHint.deposits: Refund deadline and the legal cap
groupHint.access: Door codes for repairs, visitors and viewings

desc.billing_cutoff: When the billing period closes and charges are summed up
desc.billing_default_due_day: The day of the month rent is due
desc.billing_reading_grace_hours: How long readings taken after the cut-off are still accepted
desc.billing_estimate_policy: Estimate a unit without a reading, or wait for the real one
desc.billing_auto_issue: Send computed bills by themselves when nobody changes them
desc.invoice_min_lead_days: The fewest days between a bill and its due date
desc.reminders_schedule: The days after the due date a LINE reminder goes out
desc.late_fee_enabled: Charge a fee on overdue bills
desc.payments_allow_partial: Residents may pay part of a bill
desc.payments_allow_slip: Residents may send a transfer slip to be checked
desc.payments_duplicate_window_hours: A payment matching a slip within this window is held for a check
desc.notifications_quiet_hours: Non-urgent messages wait until this window ends
desc.analytics_csat_survey_interval_days: How long after an answer the survey is offered again
desc.readings_require_photo: Readings typed by hand need a photo of the dial
desc.readings_round_window_days: The days staff have to read the meters each round
desc.readings_plausibility_pct: Readings further than this from usual wait for a check
desc.deposit_refund_days: Days after move-out to refund the deposit
desc.deposit_max_months_short: The most deposit and advance rent may add up to
desc.access_work_order_window_hours: How long a repair's door code works when no time was booked
desc.access_resident_visitor_codes: Residents create codes for their own guests in the app
desc.access_resident_visitor_max_hours: The longest a resident's visitor code may last
desc.access_battery_low_pct: Open a repair when a lock battery falls below this
desc.viewing_self_enabled: Prospects view a unit on their own with a time-boxed code
desc.viewing_self_code_minutes: The code still works after the slot starts
desc.viewing_self_code_early_minutes: The code starts working before the slot
desc.viewing_self_overstay_minutes: Tell the team when a viewer stays past the window
desc.etax_enabled: Send receipts and tax invoices to the e-Tax provider
desc.etax_provider: The provider that signs and files the documents
desc.etax_seller_branch: As registered with the Revenue Department
desc.tm30_notify_within_hours: Notify Immigration within this time of a foreign resident's arrival
desc.compliance_tariff_cap_severity: When a price is above the legal cap: warn, or refuse it
desc.compliance_tariff_cap_representative_uni: Used for the sample bill when a new price is set
desc.tenant_subject_to_ocpb_2568: Apply the Contract Committee's notification rules
